name: Bynk toolchain
description: Installs the Bynk driver, compiler and language server (bynk, bynkc, bynkc-lsp) from one checksum-verified GitHub Release, plus wrangler and TypeScript for bynk dev and bynk test. Node comes from the official Node feature.

version.description: The Bynk release to install: a tag such as v0.330.4 (the leading v is optional), or latest. All three binaries come from this one release.

wrangler.description: Install wrangler@4 globally with npm (bynk dev and deploy). Needs Node.

typescript.description: Install TypeScript globally with npm (the tsc that bynk test type-checks with). Needs Node.
